name: cmg-electrical-inventory
description: Centralized inventory management for CMG Electrical substations

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db:start" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.setup:demo: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server run seed:demo
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.reset-passwords: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server run reset-passwords
